python3 -c "
import numpy as np, trimesh, math
from cadverify.cadcheck.mesh import load_exact
from cadverify.cadcheck import section
from cadverify.cadcheck.assembly import _poses, _box_gap, overlap
w = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.1d428528.stl')
b = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.57cfb177.stl')
names = {'wheel1': {'name':'wheel1','_mesh':w,'_solid':section.to_manifold(w)}, 'base1': {'name':'base1','_mesh':b,'_solid':section.to_manifold(b)}}
pairs = [(names['wheel1'], names['base1'])]
motion = {'name':'free','kind':'rotate','point':[0,0,4],'axis':[0,0,1],'range':[0,-30],'instances':['wheel1']}
lo,hi=-30.0,0.0; step=0.5729577950658532; count=min(360,max(1,math.ceil((hi-lo)/step))); vals=np.linspace(lo,hi,count+1)
# replicate _sweep innards but debug each pose: box gap and overlap
from cadverify.cadcheck import assembly as A
rest = {n: (names[n]['_solid'], np.reshape(names[n]['_solid'].bounding_box(),(2,3))) for n in ['wheel1','base1']}
for i,v in enumerate(vals):
    mats=_poses(motion,float(v))
    placed=dict(rest)
    for name,matrix in mats.items():
        if name in rest:
            solid=rest[name][0].transform(matrix[:3])
            placed[name]=(solid, np.reshape(solid.bounding_box(),(2,3)))
    (solid,box),(other,obox)=placed['wheel1'],placed['base1']
    g=_box_gap(box,obox)
    if g>0: print(i,round(float(v),3),'GAP',g); continue
    hit=overlap(solid,other)
    print(i,round(float(v),3),'hit' if hit else 'none', hit['volume_mm3'] if hit else '', hit['thickness_mm'] if hit else '')
